## Why choose Acumatica Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)?

Unmatched usability
Secure and reliable

### Unmatched usability

Struggling with complex systems?

Acumatica Cloud ERP offers an award-winning, user-friendly interface that’s easy to navigate,
requires minimal training, and works seamlessly on any device, empowering your team to work smarter.

[See how it works][217]
[unmatched-usability] [unmatched-usability]

### Secure and reliable

Worried about data security?

Acumatica Cloud ERP safeguards your business with a multi-layered security approach, including
robust encryption, role-based access, and compliance with global standards, giving you the
confidence to grow securely.

[Read more][218]
[secure-and-reliable] [secure-and-reliable]

### AI-powered automation

Overwhelmed by repetitive tasks?

Acumatica’s AI-driven automation simplifies your workflows by handling routine processes,
identifying anomalies, and delivering actionable insights—so your team can operate more efficiently
and focus on driving strategic growth.

[Learn more][219]
[ai-powered-automation] [ai-powered-automation]

### Trusted by customers worldwide

Frustrated with poor support and hidden fees?

Thousands of businesses trust Acumatica for its usability, transparent pricing, and industry-leading
customer satisfaction, making it the top-rated Cloud ERP solution.

[Read more][220]
[trusted-by-customers] [trusted-by-customers]

### A true cloud platform

Limited by outdated systems?

Acumatica’s true cloud-based ERP gives you secure, anytime, anywhere access with no hidden costs and
unlimited users, future-proofing your business for growth.

[Learn more][221]

Simplify **complex processes** with a **user-friendly interface** that boosts **productivity**.

## Explore

Hit the road across a carefully recreated America. From Nevada deserts and Oregon forests to the
neon lights of Las Vegas — every city and landscape is crafted with stunning detail.

## Customize

Your truck, your rules. Pick from dozens of iconic brands and build your rig exactly the way you
want it — custom paint, chrome trims, lights, exhaust stacks, and an interior that feels like home
on the road.

## Build Your Own Logistics Empire

From driver to boss. Hire new drivers, buy more trucks, and open garages across the country. Build
your own transport empire.

## 20+ States

Many destinations, endless roads. A growing lineup of map expansions takes you across America (and
soon also Canada) — from the California coast and Route 66 to the wild plains of Montana or busy
streets of Chicago. Every state brings its own atmosphere and character.

## Cooperate

The road is better together. Start a convoy with friends, share jobs, and roll across states in one
shared world with synced traffic, weather, and time.

## Learn

You're not on your own. The Driving Academy walks you through everything - from gear shifting to
reversing a trailer into the tightest dock. Drive like a pro, no matter your level.

  Beiersdorf will publish its Half-Year Report 2026 on August 5, 2026 at 08:00 CEST.
  
  [Find out more][174]
* ## THE INVENTORS OF MODERN SKIN CARE
  
  Beiersdorf is a global leader in skin care, driven by over 140 years of innovation and care. Since
  1882, we have made people feel good in their skin. 
  
  [DISCOVER BEIERSDORF][175]
* ## ICONIC SKIN CARE BRANDS
  
  All over the world, millions of consumers start and end their day with our Beiersdorf products. We
  are proud of our strong portfolio full of pioneering innovation.
  
  [DISCOVER OUR BRANDS][176]
* ## GAME-CHANGER FOR SKIN TONE MANAGEMENT
  
  Thiamidol® is our signature ingredient that helps you manage your skin tone. It is our most
  effective ingredient against all major forms of hyperpigmentation.
  
  [DISCOVER THIAMIDOL®][177]
* ## SHAPE WHAT’S NEXT IN SKIN CARE
  
  Join a team with ambitious goals and a heart full of care.
  
  [JOIN BEIERSDORF][178]
* ## A MILESTONE IN SKIN REJUVENATION
  
  Learn about our breakthrough epigenetic ingredient EPICELLINE®, which reverses skin age and
  activates skin longevity.
  
  [DISCOVER EPICELLINE®][179]

* ## Half-Year Report 2026
  
  Beiersdorf will publish its Half-Year Report 2026 on August 5, 2026 at 08:00 CEST.
  
  [Find out more][174]
* ## THE INVENTORS OF MODERN SKIN CARE
  
  Beiersdorf is a global leader in skin care, driven by over 140 years of innovation and care. Since
  1882, we have made people feel good in their skin. 
  
  [DISCOVER BEIERSDORF][175]
* ## ICONIC SKIN CARE BRANDS
  
  All over the world, millions of consumers start and end their day with our Beiersdorf products. We
  are proud of our strong portfolio full of pioneering innovation.
  
  [DISCOVER OUR BRANDS][176]
* ## GAME-CHANGER FOR SKIN TONE MANAGEMENT
  
  Thiamidol® is our signature ingredient that helps you manage your skin tone. It is our most
  effective ingredient against all major forms of hyperpigmentation.
  
  [DISCOVER THIAMIDOL®][177]
* ## SHAPE WHAT’S NEXT IN SKIN CARE
  
  Join a team with ambitious goals and a heart full of care.
  
  [JOIN BEIERSDORF][178]
* ## A MILESTONE IN SKIN REJUVENATION
  
  Learn about our breakthrough epigenetic ingredient EPICELLINE®, which reverses skin age and
  activates skin longevity.
  
  [DISCOVER EPICELLINE®][179]

## ABOUT US

Biovencer Healthcare Private Limited is one of the top leading pharmaceutical & Nutraceutical
manufacturer company based in India, offering a wide range of nutritional supplements, advanced
clinical nutrition products, and health supplements. We provide contract manufacturing & [private
label services][42] to our clients.


Our Manufacturing Unit is Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) compliance and ISO 22000:2005 (Food
Safety management system). Our company is administered by a highly-experienced, innovative team of

## Dharmani’s International

Dharmani’s International is a trusted ayurvedic products manufacturer with over two decades of
expertise in delivering high-quality herbal, nutraceutical, and cosmetic solutions. Our Company is
built on a legacy of innovation, trust and compliance. We collaborate with stronger brands like:
VG3, Long Looks, Apollo, Instant Veda and so on. We at Dharmani’s International strengthen our
position among leading personal care products manufacturers and reliable pharma exporters in India.
We approach our work driven by quality standards, science and responsibility for the long term value
creation for both the partners and consumers With a diverse and future-ready portfolio, Dharmani’s
International addresses evolving market needs through advanced skincare product formulation, herbal
supplements, nutraceuticals, and personal care solutions. From concept development and formulation
to manufacturing, packaging, and exports, we offer end-to-end, customised services under one roof,
supported by international quality standards and a partner-first mindset. [Read more][17]

## Services

With a wide range of products and services, Dharmanis International is a contract manufacturer that
has carved a niche for itself globally. From [contract manufacturing services ][18] to the Private
label and custom formulations, our services span a diverse spectrum. Bring us your requirements and
we’ll handle the rest with customized manufacturing and packaging services just the way you need
them.

### Private Label

We assist companies with introducing wellness, hygiene and personal care products that are ready for
the market under their own brand. We guarantee quality, compliance and speed to market from
formulation to packaging.

[Know More][19] [Talk to Us][20]

### Contract Manufacturing

Our company offers turnkey contract manufacturing along with improved facilities, ranging from
formulations to packaging, under stringent standards of quality. Our processes are scalable, thus
ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and continuity in meeting demands.

[Know More][21] [Talk to Us][22]

### Custom Formulations

In case you have a concept or an idea related to any custom product, we would be able to create a
scientifically rooted and customized formulation according to your product concept.

[Know More][23] [Talk to Us][24]

### Bulk Packaging

We provide flexible bulk packaging solutions designed for efficiency, safety and ease of handling.
Our capabilities support high-volume requirements while maintaining product integrity and quality

[Know More][25] [Talk to Us][26]

### Brand Partnerships

Looking for a partner for your brand or want to retail a brand? We have more than 15 Brands
registered in different niches and we are always looking for potential people to partner with in
various countries.

[Know More][27] [Talk to Us][28]

Over 1500 formulations have been successfully formulated by our well-trained R&D teams for domestic

## La piel que sueñas, con el respaldo dermatológico especializado que mereces.

Soy la Dra. Nathalie Quiroz Valencia, Médica y Dermatóloga egresada de la Universidad del Valle,
experta en dermatología estética, manejo del acné y tricología.

[Contacto][17]

## Nuestros Servicios

Tu piel es nuestra prioridad

[Consulta dermatologica en cali]

Evaluación y diagnóstico

Cita programada con la médica dermatóloga quien revisa y realiza un diagnóstico de la piel y con
base en él, recomienda la mejor opción para la piel del paciente. Así mismo evalúa a que
procedimientos podría ser candidato el paciente.

[Dermatologia cali]

Tratamiento para el acné

El acné es la patología mas común de la piel, que afecta gran parte de la población adolescente y
adulta. Contamos con los mejores tratamientos tanto dermatológicos como estéticos para  controlar el
acné, manejar las cicatrices y dejar tu piel saludable y sana.

[Labios hialuronico Cali]

Tratamientos de dermatología Clínica

Ofrecemos todos los servicios relacionados con procedimientos para enfermedades de la piel, pelo y
uñas : biopsia, crioterapia, fulguración, resección verrugas y lunares.

[Labios hialuronico cali]

Tratamientos de dermatología estética

Somos especialistas en el cuidado de tu piel en todos los ámbitos: contamos con procedimientos

## Dra. Nathalie Quiroz Valencia

Médica Dermatóloga – Especialista en Dermatología Clínica, Estética y Capilar


Soy médica egresada de la Universidad del Valle, con especialización en Dermatología y Cirugía
Dermatológica. Mi pasión por el cuidado integral de la piel me llevó a profundizar en áreas clave
como la estética y la tricología, siempre con el objetivo de ofrecer a mis pacientes soluciones
completas, seguras y con base científica.

* Especialización en Dermatología y Cirugía Dermatológica – Universidad del Valle
* Máster en Dermatología Estética – Universidad de Alcalá de Henares, Madrid
* Diplomado en Tricología (salud capilar) – CILAD
* Diplomado en Dermatología Estética – CILAD
* Diplomado en Psicodermatologia - CILAD (actualmente) 


Creo firmemente en un enfoque humano y personalizado para cada paciente. Más allá del diagnóstico y
el tratamiento, me enfoco en educar, acompañar y crear una experiencia positiva para quienes confían
en mí.


Cuidar tu piel es cuidar tu salud, tu autoestima y tu bienestar. Estoy aquí para ayudarte a
lograrlo.

## Custom Manufacturing

Fermentis Life Sciences has extensive experience producing nutraceuticals and health supplements in
a number of dose formats. Depending on the type of dosage form, we employ different procedures to
prepare it.

[ read more ][124]

## Tablet Manufacturing

Tablets are basically compressed powder that can be formed into any desired shape of choice. When
compared to capsules, a tablet has the advantage of being able to pack more powder into a smaller
pill. These are the tablets we make –

Direct compressed tablets

Wet granulation process

Dry granulation process

Coated tablets

## Capsule Manufacturing

Capsules are easy to dissolve and can hold pellets and powdered blends very nicely. They are ideal
for micronutrient requirements. The shell can be produced from a variety of materials, including
gelatin or a vegetarian-friendly formulation. We manufacture these types of capsules –

Capsules with natural extracts

Wet & dry granulated capsules

Vegetarian capsules

Capsule filling

## Powdered blends

These can be consumed in milk or water. There are various products that can be made into powdered
blends like protein powders, shakes, and health drinks to name a few. The process is as follows-

(1) Raw material collection

(2) Blending them into a homogenous mixture

(3) Filling it into ideal packaging material

(4) Labelling and sealing

## Gummies

These are the latest trends in the nutraceutical industry. It is easy and yummy. Following is the
process –

(1) Ingredient mixing homogeneously

(2) Transferring to desirable shape

(3) Cooling

(4) Unmolding

(5) Packing into bottles

## Liquids

These are perfect for on-the-go shots for products like proteins, amino acids or even energy water.
The process for liquids is –

(1) Blending of all the ingredients into a homogenous mixture

(2) Heating or cooling according to the product requirement

(3) Bottling it into ideal packaging material

(4) Testing and bulk packaging

## Softgel Manufacturing

Softgels can be adjusted in terms of shape, colour, and size to fit your needs. Softgels encapsulate
liquids rather than powder, resulting in greater absorbability.

(1) Gelatin Filling & Encapsulation

(2) Fill Material Preparation

(3) Drying Tunnel Cleaning

(4) Final Inspection

(5) Tumble Drying

## Tablet Manufacturing

Tablets are basically compressed powder that can be formed into any desired shape of choice. When
compared to capsules, a tablet has the advantage of being able to pack more powder into a smaller
pill. These are the tablets we make –

Direct compressed tablets

Wet granulation process

Dry granulation process

Coated tablets

## Capsule Manufacturing

Capsules are easy to dissolve and can hold pellets and powdered blends very nicely. They are ideal
for micronutrient requirements. The shell can be produced from a variety of materials, including
gelatin or a vegetarian-friendly formulation. We manufacture these types of capsules –

Capsules with natural extracts

Wet & dry granulated capsules

Vegetarian capsules

Capsule filling

## Powdered blends

These can be consumed in milk or water. There are various products that can be made into powdered
blends like protein powders, shakes, and health drinks to name a few. The process is as follows-

(1) Raw material collection

(2) Blending them into a homogenous mixture

(3) Filling it into ideal packaging material

(4) Labelling and sealing

## Gummies

These are the latest trends in the nutraceutical industry. It is easy and yummy. Following is the
process –

(1) Ingredient mixing homogeneously

(2) Transferring to desirable shape

(3) Cooling

(4) Unmolding

## Liquids

These are perfect for on-the-go shots for products like proteins, amino acids or even energy water.
The process for liquids is –

(1) Blending of all the ingredients into a homogenous mixture

(2) Heating or cooling according to the product requirement

(3) Bottling it into ideal packaging material

(4) Testing and bulk packaging

Softgels can be adjusted in terms of shape, colour, and size to fit your needs. Softgels encapsulate
liquids rather than powder, resulting in greater absorbability.

#### บริการผลิตและสร้าง
#### แบรนด์ครบวงจร

KOVIC ONE STOP SERVICE ที่เดียวจบครบวงจร ตั้งแต่การให้คำปรึกษาจากผู้เชี่ยวชาญ การผลิตด้วยเครื่องจักรทันสมัย จดทะเบียน
อย. ออกแบบบรรจุภัณฑ์ พร้อมจำหน่าย

#### วัตถุดิบการผลิต
#### ชั้นเยี่ยม คุณภาพสูง

วัตถุดิบคุณภาพจากทั่วโลกที่ได้มาตรฐาน และถูกต้องตามกฎหมาย นำมาพัฒนาสูตรอาหารเสริม ด้วยเทคโนโลยีและนวัตกรรมใหม่ ๆ
รวมถึงการผลิตตัวอย่างสินค้าให้ลูกค้า เพื่อความมั่นใจในคุณภาพและผลลัพธ์ของผลิตภัณฑ์

#### มาตรฐานการผลิต
#### ระดับโลก

รับรองการผลิตด้วยมาตรฐานสากลระดับโลก GMP Codex, HACCP, HALAL, ISO และได้รับรางวัลนวัตกรรมระดับสากล
มั่นใจได้ว่าผลิตภัณฑ์ของบริษัท มีคุณภาพสูงสุด ปลอดภัย ใช้แล้วได้ผลจริง

#### วิจัยและพัฒนา
#### อย่างต่อเนื่อง

โรงงานผลิตอาหารเสริมของเรา มีทีมนักวิจัย ที่คิดค้น และพัฒนาสูตรอาหารเสริมขึ้นมาโดยเฉพาะ
โดยลูกค้ามีส่วนร่วมในการคิดค้นสูตรอาหารเสริม เพื่อให้ตรงกับความต้องการของลูกค้าเจ้าของแบรนด์มากที่สุด

### What's New

## KOVIC KATE INTERNATIONAL คว้ารางวัลระดับนานาชาติ International Invention and Trade Expo 2023 (ITE)

### ผลิตเครื่องสำอาง ครีม สกินแคร์

#### KOVIC KATE เป็นหนึ่งในผู้นำด้านการผลิตเครื่องสำอางและครีมอันดับต้นๆ ของประเทศ
#### โรงงานของเรานั้นรับผลิตเครื่องสำอางและครีมทุกชนิด ได้แก่ สกินแคร์ เวชสำอางจากธรรมชาติ เครื่องสำอางจากสมุนไพร

[ตอกย้ำความสำเร็จอย่างยิ่งใหญ่อีกครั้งในการเป็นผู้นำด้านธุรกิจรับจ้างผลิต (OEM Service & Contract Manufacturing)

### ผลิตอาหารเสริม ผลิตภัณฑ์เสริมอาหาร

### ผลิตอาหารเสริม

#### KOVIC KATE เป็นโรงงานผลิตผลิตภัณฑ์เสริมอาหารและเครื่องสำอางระดับต้นของประเทศ
#### ที่มีประสบการณ์การสร้างแบรนด์ให้กับลูกค้ามามากกว่า 2 ทศวรรษ
#### KOVIC เน้นการสร้างแบรนด์ผลิตสินค้าให้กับลูกค้าเท่านั้น เพื่อตอบสนองตามความต้องการของลูกค้า ซึ่งมั่นใจได้ว่าบริษัทฯ
#### จะไม่ใช้สูตรซ้ำกัน และไม่มีการทำสินค้าเป็นแบรนด์ของโรงงานเองเพื่อแข่งขันกับลูกค้า

[supplementary-skincare-oem]

### ผลิตเครื่องสำอาง สกินแคร์

### ผลิตเครื่องสำอาง ครีม สกินแคร์

#### KOVIC KATE เป็นหนึ่งในผู้นำด้านการผลิตเครื่องสำอางและครีมอันดับต้นๆ ของประเทศ
#### โรงงานของเรานั้นรับผลิตเครื่องสำอางและครีมทุกชนิด ได้แก่ สกินแคร์ เวชสำอางจากธรรมชาติ เครื่องสำอางจากสมุนไพร
#### มาร์ค โลชั่นเซรั่มเสริมความงาม เป็นต้น โดยเรามาบริการอย่างครบถ้วนเพื่อตอบโจทย์ความต้องการของลูกค้าทุกรูปแบบ
#### รวมถึงให้บริการปรึกษาด้านการตลาด การออกแบบโลโก้สินค้าและบรรจุภัณฑ์ การทำตลาดออนไลน์ รับจัดทำสื่อต่างๆ
#### เพื่อโปรโมทสินค้า จัดอีเว้นท์เปิดตัวสินค้า จัดกิจกรรรมส่งเสริมการขาย

[supplement-Herbal-extraction-oem]

### ผลิตยาแผนโบราณ สมุนไพร และสารสกัด

### ผลิตยาแผนโบราณ และสารสกัด

#### KOVIC KATE รับผลิตสารสกัดและยาแผนโบราณหลากหลายประเภท ซึ่งมีการคัดสรรเฉพาะวัตถุดิบคุณภาพดีจากแหล่งที่น่าเชื่อถือ
#### อีกทั้งยังพิถีพิถันในการพัฒนาและการผลิตโดยทีมงานที่มีคุณภาพ มีการพัฒนาและการผลิตโดยทีมงานผู้เชี่ยวชาญ นักวิทยาศาสตร์
#### นักเคมีและเภสัชกร รูปแบบผลิตภัณฑ์ที่รับผลิต ในหมวดหมู่สารสกัดได้แก่ น้ำมันหอมระเหย สารสกัดแบบเหลว และสารสกัดแบบผง
#### ซึ่งสารสกัดสมุนไพรเหล่านี้สามารถนำไปใช้เป็นวัตถุดิบในการผลิตยาแผนโบราณ เครื่องสำอาง และอาหารเสริมต่าง ๆ

### International Invention & Trade Expo Award

#### แบรนด์ครบวงจร

KOVIC ONE STOP SERVICE ที่เดียวจบครบวงจร ตั้งแต่การให้คำปรึกษาจากผู้เชี่ยวชาญ การผลิตด้วยเครื่องจักรทันสมัย จดทะเบียน
อย. ออกแบบบรรจุภัณฑ์ พร้อมจำหน่าย

#### วัตถุดิบการผลิต
#### ชั้นเยี่ยม คุณภาพสูง

วัตถุดิบคุณภาพจากทั่วโลกที่ได้มาตรฐาน และถูกต้องตามกฎหมาย นำมาพัฒนาสูตรอาหารเสริม ด้วยเทคโนโลยีและนวัตกรรมใหม่ ๆ
รวมถึงการผลิตตัวอย่างสินค้าให้ลูกค้า เพื่อความมั่นใจในคุณภาพและผลลัพธ์ของผลิตภัณฑ์

#### มาตรฐานการผลิต
#### ระดับโลก

รับรองการผลิตด้วยมาตรฐานสากลระดับโลก GMP Codex, HACCP, HALAL, ISO และได้รับรางวัลนวัตกรรมระดับสากล
มั่นใจได้ว่าผลิตภัณฑ์ของบริษัท มีคุณภาพสูงสุด ปลอดภัย ใช้แล้วได้ผลจริง

#### วิจัยและพัฒนา
#### อย่างต่อเนื่อง

โรงงานผลิตอาหารเสริมของเรา มีทีมนักวิจัย ที่คิดค้น และพัฒนาสูตรอาหารเสริมขึ้นมาโดยเฉพาะ
โดยลูกค้ามีส่วนร่วมในการคิดค้นสูตรอาหารเสริม เพื่อให้ตรงกับความต้องการของลูกค้าเจ้าของแบรนด์มากที่สุด

### What's New

## KOVIC KATE INTERNATIONAL คว้ารางวัลระดับนานาชาติ International Invention and Trade Expo 2023 (ITE)

[ตอกย้ำความสำเร็จอย่างยิ่งใหญ่อีกครั้งในการเป็นผู้นำด้านธุรกิจรับจ้างผลิต (OEM Service & Contract Manufacturing)
สำหรับผลิตภัณฑ์เสริมอาหาร เครื่องสําอาง ครีมบำรุงผิว ยาแผนโบราณ ผลิตภัณฑ์จากสมุนไพร
และสารสกัดจากสมุนไพรที่ผสมผสานความเป็นนวัตกรรมสากลได้อย่างลงตัว โดยเมื่อเร็วๆ บริษัทฯ ได้รับเหรียญรางวัล ใบประกาศ
และถ้วยรางวัลหลากหลายรางวัลจากการประกวดสินค้าและนวัตกรรมระดับนานาชาติ International Invention and Trade Expo
2023 (ITE) ที่จัดขึ้นระหว่างวันที่ 5 – 6 ตุลาคม 2566 ณ Kingston University กรุงลอนดอน ประเทศอังกฤษ
ซึ่งรางวัลดังกล่าวสามารถเพิ่มมูลค่าและต่อยอดให้กับผลิตภัณฑ์สุขภาพและความงามได้ในระดับสากล ][21]

### ผลิตอาหารเสริม ผลิตภัณฑ์เสริมอาหาร

### ผลิตอาหารเสริม

#### KOVIC KATE เป็นโรงงานผลิตผลิตภัณฑ์เสริมอาหารและเครื่องสำอางระดับต้นของประเทศ
#### ที่มีประสบการณ์การสร้างแบรนด์ให้กับลูกค้ามามากกว่า 2 ทศวรรษ
#### KOVIC เน้นการสร้างแบรนด์ผลิตสินค้าให้กับลูกค้าเท่านั้น เพื่อตอบสนองตามความต้องการของลูกค้า ซึ่งมั่นใจได้ว่าบริษัทฯ
#### จะไม่ใช้สูตรซ้ำกัน และไม่มีการทำสินค้าเป็นแบรนด์ของโรงงานเองเพื่อแข่งขันกับลูกค้า

[supplementary-skincare-oem]

### ผลิตเครื่องสำอาง สกินแคร์

### ผลิตเครื่องสำอาง ครีม สกินแคร์

#### KOVIC KATE เป็นหนึ่งในผู้นำด้านการผลิตเครื่องสำอางและครีมอันดับต้นๆ ของประเทศ
#### โรงงานของเรานั้นรับผลิตเครื่องสำอางและครีมทุกชนิด ได้แก่ สกินแคร์ เวชสำอางจากธรรมชาติ เครื่องสำอางจากสมุนไพร
#### มาร์ค โลชั่นเซรั่มเสริมความงาม เป็นต้น โดยเรามาบริการอย่างครบถ้วนเพื่อตอบโจทย์ความต้องการของลูกค้าทุกรูปแบบ
#### รวมถึงให้บริการปรึกษาด้านการตลาด การออกแบบโลโก้สินค้าและบรรจุภัณฑ์ การทำตลาดออนไลน์ รับจัดทำสื่อต่างๆ
#### เพื่อโปรโมทสินค้า จัดอีเว้นท์เปิดตัวสินค้า จัดกิจกรรรมส่งเสริมการขาย

[supplement-Herbal-extraction-oem]

### ผลิตยาแผนโบราณ สมุนไพร และสารสกัด

### ผลิตยาแผนโบราณ และสารสกัด

#### KOVIC KATE รับผลิตสารสกัดและยาแผนโบราณหลากหลายประเภท ซึ่งมีการคัดสรรเฉพาะวัตถุดิบคุณภาพดีจากแหล่งที่น่าเชื่อถือ
#### อีกทั้งยังพิถีพิถันในการพัฒนาและการผลิตโดยทีมงานที่มีคุณภาพ มีการพัฒนาและการผลิตโดยทีมงานผู้เชี่ยวชาญ นักวิทยาศาสตร์
#### นักเคมีและเภสัชกร รูปแบบผลิตภัณฑ์ที่รับผลิต ในหมวดหมู่สารสกัดได้แก่ น้ำมันหอมระเหย สารสกัดแบบเหลว และสารสกัดแบบผง
#### ซึ่งสารสกัดสมุนไพรเหล่านี้สามารถนำไปใช้เป็นวัตถุดิบในการผลิตยาแผนโบราณ เครื่องสำอาง และอาหารเสริมต่าง ๆ

Evolution of time has led to the disappearance of various ideas, concepts, and other age old
beliefs, that had once played an important role in human lives. However, one thing that has made a
drastic comeback is the concept of Ayurveda.

It is one of the most ancient sciences, that offered to mankind the solution to varied problems, by
sharing insight into the use of various herbs and spices that are naturally available around us; a
perfect combination and proportion of which would work miracle to human body. The magic that
Ayurveda created helped people to get rid of various diseases and health issues, within no time at
all.

The impact of Ayurveda and the immense benefits it has to offer has led the modern generation to
divert more towards the use of Ayurvedic products, which is very much safe and natural as compared
to harmful clinical medicines. This is another reason why there are so many Ayurvedic Products
Suppliers in India.

The various benefits of ayurvedic products:

* These have guaranteed results: This is definitely one thing that can be expected of these

* These can be bought cheap: This is again one of the best advantages that the people can actually
  have. The ayurvedic products can be often bought at great prices and thus people can make sure
  that they can buy these and use them regularly.
  
* Solution to every problem: There is almost no problem that cannot be treated with the help of the
  ayurvedic products. This is definitely one thing that the people need to know of. This is
  apparently why the numbers of the Ayurvedic Products Manufacturer in India are daily increasing.
  
* Available almost everywhere: These ayurvedic products can be now easily available everywhere. With
  the evolution of modern technology ordering it from places that manufacture these products and
  getting delivered these to faraway places is not difficult anymore.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

Glycative Stress Research

Original article

Evaluation in vitro of AGE-crosslinks breaking ability of rosmarinic acid

 

Daniel Jean 1), Maryse Pouligon 1), Claude Dalle 2)

 

1) Institut des Substances Végétales, Beaumont, France

2) World Society Interdisciplinary Anti-aging Medicine, Paris, France

Abstract

 

Objective: Although numerous works were carried out to evaluate the ability of various molecules to
break AGE, none of them, to our best knowledge, were done to evaluate the ability of these molecules
to break protein crosslinks considered globally. The objective of this work was to show clearly the
albumin polymerization elicited by reaction with ribose and the ability of a polyphenolic acid
extracted from rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis), rosmarinic acid, to break preformed albumin
polymers.

Methods: Albumin was glycated by incubation with ribose and the resulting albumin polymers were
evaluated by the size exclusion Chromatography (SEC) and fluorimetry. After elimination of ribose by
dialysis, the proteins were treated by rosmarinic acid, aminoguanidine, carnosine, and Alagebrium
(ALT-711; Alteon) as a positive control. Reversion of glycation was measured by the ratio between
polymerized and native albumin before and after treatment by the reversing molecules.

Results: Rosmarinic acid was shown to be an as good crosslinks-breaker as Alagebrium. At the
opposite, aminoguanidine and carnosine, the glycation reaction inhibitors do not produce a
significant reversion of albumin polymerization.

Discussion: Albumin polymerization elicited by glycation by ribose can be measured by SEC and
fluorimetry of the resulting polymers. We have shown that rosmarinic acid is able to reverse this
polymerization to a similar extent to Alagebrium.

Conclusion: Rosmarinic acid seems a promising molecule, known as safe and able in vitro to break
protein AGE-related crosslinks approximately as efficiently as Alagebrium, considered until now as
the reference molecule in this field. It could be a promising treatment of diabetics, skin aging,
and of elderly impaired vessels-related diseases as nephropathy, neuropathy and retinopathy.

Evaluation in vitro of AGE-crosslinacidks breaking ability of rosmarinic

Accepted : November 21, 2015

Published online : December 31, 2015.

Glycative Stress Research

Original article

Evaluation in vitro of AGE-crosslinks breaking ability of rosmarinic acid

 

Daniel Jean 1), Maryse Pouligon 1), Claude Dalle 2)

 

1) Institut des Substances Végétales, Beaumont, France

2) World Society Interdisciplinary Anti-aging Medicine, Paris, France

Abstract

 

Objective: Although numerous works were carried out to evaluate the ability of various molecules to
break AGE, none of them, to our best knowledge, were done to evaluate the ability of these molecules
to break protein crosslinks considered globally. The objective of this work was to show clearly the
albumin polymerization elicited by reaction with ribose and the ability of a polyphenolic acid
extracted from rosemary (Rosmarinus officinalis), rosmarinic acid, to break preformed albumin
polymers.

Methods: Albumin was glycated by incubation with ribose and the resulting albumin polymers were
evaluated by the size exclusion Chromatography (SEC) and fluorimetry. After elimination of ribose by
dialysis, the proteins were treated by rosmarinic acid, aminoguanidine, carnosine, and Alagebrium
(ALT-711; Alteon) as a positive control. Reversion of glycation was measured by the ratio between
polymerized and native albumin before and after treatment by the reversing molecules.

Results: Rosmarinic acid was shown to be an as good crosslinks-breaker as Alagebrium. At the
opposite, aminoguanidine and carnosine, the glycation reaction inhibitors do not produce a
significant reversion of albumin polymerization.

Discussion: Albumin polymerization elicited by glycation by ribose can be measured by SEC and
fluorimetry of the resulting polymers. We have shown that rosmarinic acid is able to reverse this
polymerization to a similar extent to Alagebrium.

Conclusion: Rosmarinic acid seems a promising molecule, known as safe and able in vitro to break
protein AGE-related crosslinks approximately as efficiently as Alagebrium, considered until now as
the reference molecule in this field. It could be a promising treatment of diabetics, skin aging,
and of elderly impaired vessels-related diseases as nephropathy, neuropathy and retinopathy.

# POWERED BY EXPERIENCE. DRIVEN BY INNOVATION.

### PRIVATE LABEL SKINCARE

Cosmetic Solutions offers full turnkey private label skincare services to emerging and established
brands as well as medical professionals, spas and salons and online retailers. **Our Innovation
Team **works closely with all partners to create unique, highly-effective products sold in premium
packaging that are ready for launch.

[Read More][58]

### CONTRACT MANUFACTURING

Our high-tech, optimized manufacturing facility is located on-site in our 100,000 square foot
Innovation Campus headquarters in Boca Raton, Florida. The masterful Production Team stringently
adheres to all GMP standards during formulation, production, and post-product processes. We are also
ISO 22716 certified and FDA-registered.

[Read More][59]

### CUSTOM FORMULATION

For brands looking for something that is uniquely their own, our team of R&D Specialists – located
within our in-house laboratory can create a formulation tailored exactly to your specifications.
Whether it be a cleanser, exfoliator, moisturizer or results-driven treatment product, we will work
with you from concept to shelf.packaging that are ready for launch.

[Read More][60]

## What’s happening to your hair starts beneath the surface.

### Hormones

DHT sensitivity can be caused by genetics, stress, poor diet, and toxins.

### Stress

Physical or emotional stress like giving birth or a demanding job.

### Lifestyle

Refers to your surroundings, the products you use, and the foods you eat.

### Metabolism

### How do I get started?

You're unique, and your hair growth plan should be too. That's why we created our [Hair Wellness
Quiz][41]—a quick 3-minute assessment that allows us to better understand your specific root causes
of hair thinning and recommend a personalized product regimen that will give you results.

### How do I qualify for the Real Growth Guarantee^{∞}?

It's easy! Purchase 6 bottles of any Nutraceutical through a subscription within 180 days, take 4
capsules each day, and download the myNutrafol app within 30 days of placing your first order. Make
sure to check in regularly and submit monthly progress photos in the app.

[View all FAQs][42]

### Is Nutrafol suitable for everyone?

Not only is Nutrafol suitable for most people, but our hair growth supplements are specifically
formulated to meet you where you are in life. We have 5 Nutraceutical formulas that are tailored to
the bio-specific needs of men and women throughout all life stages: Women's, Women’s Vegan,
Postpartum for the first year after childbirth or while breastfeeding, Women's Balance for peri- and
postmenopause, and Men's.

Please note: We do not recommend Nutrafol to anyone under the age of 18. Also, while we have no
reason to believe it's harmful, there have not been enough studies for us to say Nutrafol is
suitable during pregnancy—so we recommend skipping it while pregnant or trying to conceive and
sticking with Nutrafol Postpartum while breastfeeding. If you have a medical condition, or are
taking medications (especially anticoagulant and blood-thinning drugs), please consult with your
physician before taking Nutrafol.

### What is the difference between Nutrafol's Hair Growth Nutraceuticals?

Our Hair Growth Nutraceuticals are clinically effective and physician-formulated to the bio-specific
needs of men and women through all life stages and lifestyles.^{*} The key root causes of thinning
hair affect men and women differently and can change over time—so we created multiple formulas to
give your hair exactly what it needs, when it needs it most.

Women’s formula focuses on addressing the key root causes of hair thinning for women 18-44 years old
when stress, lifestyle habits, and nutrition play a heightened role in hair health.

Women’s Vegan is formulated for women 18-44 with the key root causes of thinning focusing on stress
and lifestyle habits, plus it is optimized to support plant-based diet’s nutrition and absorption of
nutrients in the body that affect hair health.

Women’s Balance is formulated for women 45+ to support the key root causes of hair thinning for
women, such as stress, with optimized support for hormonal changes, such as menopause, that affect
hair health.

Postpartum is OBGYN-formulated to address the key root causes of hair thinning and shedding for
women within the first year of giving birth and through the time they are breastfeeding, such as the
physical and emotional stress, hormonal changes, and nutritional support.

Men’s formula multi-targets the key root causes of thinning for men 18+, such as stress and poor
nutrition, with optimized support of hair growth-inhibiting DHT hormone, without compromising sexual
performance.

### Will Nutrafol work for my hair type?

Nutrafol was formulated to promote hair growth for all types of hair. While the characteristics of
hair strands may vary by ethnicity, the underlying root causes that affect hair follicles can affect
all people equally.

In a recent clinical study, we examined the effectiveness of Nutrafol in African American, Asian,
Hispanic, and Non Hispanic men and women. All ethnicities saw less shedding after two months and
improved thickness, growth rate, scalp coverage, and shine after six months.

### When can I expect to see results?

Everyone's experience is different, but in our clinical studies, women showed results in 3-6 months.
It's important to remember that healthy hair growth takes time—and of course, consistency is key. If
you take Nutrafol daily, here's a snapshot of what you're likely to experience:

1-3 months: Strengthen hair from within. Look for shinier hair with less shedding and breakage.

3-6 months: You may notice improvement in fullness and volume.

6+ months: Experience visible changes like faster-growing hair that’s thicker and stronger with more
scalp coverage.

Commitment to Nutrafol has whole-body rewards, too. Our ingredients are shown to promote more
restful sleep, less stress, better mood, and clearer skin. A little something we call side benefits.

Quiz][41]—a quick 3-minute assessment that allows us to better understand your specific root causes
of hair thinning and recommend a personalized product regimen that will give you results.

### How do I qualify for the Real Growth Guarantee^{∞}?

It's easy! Purchase 6 bottles of any Nutraceutical through a subscription within 180 days, take 4
capsules each day, and download the myNutrafol app within 30 days of placing your first order. Make
sure to check in regularly and submit monthly progress photos in the app.

[View all FAQs][42]

### Is Nutrafol suitable for everyone?

Not only is Nutrafol suitable for most people, but our hair growth supplements are specifically
formulated to meet you where you are in life. We have 5 Nutraceutical formulas that are tailored to
the bio-specific needs of men and women throughout all life stages: Women's, Women’s Vegan,
Postpartum for the first year after childbirth or while breastfeeding, Women's Balance for peri- and
postmenopause, and Men's.

Please note: We do not recommend Nutrafol to anyone under the age of 18. Also, while we have no
reason to believe it's harmful, there have not been enough studies for us to say Nutrafol is
suitable during pregnancy—so we recommend skipping it while pregnant or trying to conceive and
sticking with Nutrafol Postpartum while breastfeeding. If you have a medical condition, or are
taking medications (especially anticoagulant and blood-thinning drugs), please consult with your
physician before taking Nutrafol.

### What is the difference between Nutrafol's Hair Growth Nutraceuticals?

Our Hair Growth Nutraceuticals are clinically effective and physician-formulated to the bio-specific
needs of men and women through all life stages and lifestyles.^{*} The key root causes of thinning
hair affect men and women differently and can change over time—so we created multiple formulas to
give your hair exactly what it needs, when it needs it most.

Women’s formula focuses on addressing the key root causes of hair thinning for women 18-44 years old
when stress, lifestyle habits, and nutrition play a heightened role in hair health.

Women’s Vegan is formulated for women 18-44 with the key root causes of thinning focusing on stress
and lifestyle habits, plus it is optimized to support plant-based diet’s nutrition and absorption of
nutrients in the body that affect hair health.

Women’s Balance is formulated for women 45+ to support the key root causes of hair thinning for
women, such as stress, with optimized support for hormonal changes, such as menopause, that affect
hair health.

Postpartum is OBGYN-formulated to address the key root causes of hair thinning and shedding for
women within the first year of giving birth and through the time they are breastfeeding, such as the
physical and emotional stress, hormonal changes, and nutritional support.

Men’s formula multi-targets the key root causes of thinning for men 18+, such as stress and poor
nutrition, with optimized support of hair growth-inhibiting DHT hormone, without compromising sexual
performance.

### Will Nutrafol work for my hair type?

Nutrafol was formulated to promote hair growth for all types of hair. While the characteristics of
hair strands may vary by ethnicity, the underlying root causes that affect hair follicles can affect
all people equally.

In a recent clinical study, we examined the effectiveness of Nutrafol in African American, Asian,
Hispanic, and Non Hispanic men and women. All ethnicities saw less shedding after two months and
improved thickness, growth rate, scalp coverage, and shine after six months.

### When can I expect to see results?

Everyone's experience is different, but in our clinical studies, women showed results in 3-6 months.
It's important to remember that healthy hair growth takes time—and of course, consistency is key. If
you take Nutrafol daily, here's a snapshot of what you're likely to experience:

1-3 months: Strengthen hair from within. Look for shinier hair with less shedding and breakage.

3-6 months: You may notice improvement in fullness and volume.

6+ months: Experience visible changes like faster-growing hair that’s thicker and stronger with more
scalp coverage.

Commitment to Nutrafol has whole-body rewards, too. Our ingredients are shown to promote more
restful sleep, less stress, better mood, and clearer skin. A little something we call side benefits.

###### ARE YOU READY TO TAKE YOUR PRODUCT IDEA TO Market?

### Contract manufacturing,
### from concept to completion

**Nutrix** is an NSF ISO certified [contract manufacturer][12] of personal care products. Our
state-of-the-art FDA registered facility based in Salt Lake City, Utah produces the highest quality
of products found on the personal care and cosmetics product market today. Our focus is always on
quality, but we also understand that manufacturing a quality product is only half the battle in
creating a fantastic product that will fly off the shelves for our clients.

###### IN-HOUSE R&D LABORATORY

#### R&D Product Developement

Whether you're looking to develop a unique formula from scratch, or you just need help tweaking a
proven seller, our on-staff formulation engineers will work with you hand-in-hand to develop the
perfect product for you.

[Smarter Manufacturing]

###### SMARTER & FASTER TO MARKET

#### Smarter Manufacturing

Are you ready to take your product to market? From concept to completion, Nutrix develops your big
ideas or existing formulas into viable finished products manufactured in our state-of-the-art NSF
ISO Certified facility in Salt Lake City, Utah.

[Private Label Manufacturer]
[Private Label Manufacturer]

###### NSF ISO 9001 & SGS 22716 CERTIFIED

#### Quality Focused & Compliant

Nutrix prides itself on quality. We manufacture the right way, the first time, every time. We are an
FDA registered, NSF ISO certified company. We follow the strictest guidelines and comply with all
regulatory requirements pertaining to our industry.

### Request a quote

Are you ready to turn your idea into a finished product? We can help!
Shoot us a message using the form below and we'll be in touch as soon as possible...

### FAQs

### [ What types of personal care products does Nutrix manufacture?][13]

Nutrix manufactures a wide range of personal care products, including skincare, hair care, body
care, oral care and cosmetic items. Our offerings include facial creams, moisturizers, cleansers,
serums, hair shampoos, conditioners, and more. We cater to both custom formulations and private
label manufacturing needs.

### [ Does Nutrix offer custom formulation services?][14]

Yes, Nutrix offers custom formulation services. Whether you're creating a brand-new product or
refining an existing formula, our experienced formulation engineers work closely with you to develop
a unique product tailored to your brand’s needs.

### [ How does Nutrix assist in product development from concept to completion?][15]

Nutrix supports every step of your product development journey. From the initial idea to the final
product, we provide expert assistance in formulation, manufacturing, packaging, and labeling. Our
team ensures that your product is developed to the highest standards and is ready for market quickly
and efficiently.

### [ Does Nutrix manufacture organic and natural products?][16]

Yes, Nutrix manufactures organic and natural products. We offer a range of formulations that meet
organic and natural standards, using high-quality ingredients that align with your brand's values
and customer expectations.

### [ Do you provide packaging solutions?][17]

Absolutely! Nutrix offers comprehensive packaging solutions, from design to sourcing. We help ensure
that your product is beautifully packaged and ready for retail, offering both standard and custom
packaging options to fit your needs.

### [ What certifications does Nutrix have for quality and compliance?][18]

Nutrix holds several certifications to ensure the highest standards of quality and compliance,
including:

NSF ISO 9001
SGS 22716
FDA Registered Facility
Organic Certification (OregonTilth & USDA Organic)
Kosher Certification
HACCP Certification
SMETA Certification These certifications demonstrate our commitment to maintaining the highest
manufacturing and safety standards.

### [ What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for manufacturing?][19]

The minimum order quantity (MOQ) varies depending on the product type and customization needs. Our
team works closely with you to determine the ideal MOQ for your specific product and business
requirements.

## Ready to get started?

CALL US TODAY AT [1.855.688.7495][20]

OR EMAIL US AT [INFO@NUTRIXUSA.COM][21]

### Contract manufacturing,
### from concept to completion

**Nutrix** is an NSF ISO certified [contract manufacturer][12] of personal care products. Our
state-of-the-art FDA registered facility based in Salt Lake City, Utah produces the highest quality
of products found on the personal care and cosmetics product market today. Our focus is always on
quality, but we also understand that manufacturing a quality product is only half the battle in

[Private Label Manufacturer]

###### NSF ISO 9001 & SGS 22716 CERTIFIED

#### Quality Focused & Compliant

Nutrix prides itself on quality. We manufacture the right way, the first time, every time. We are an
FDA registered, NSF ISO certified company. We follow the strictest guidelines and comply with all
regulatory requirements pertaining to our industry.

### Request a quote

Are you ready to turn your idea into a finished product? We can help!
Shoot us a message using the form below and we'll be in touch as soon as possible...

### FAQs

### [ What types of personal care products does Nutrix manufacture?][13]

Nutrix manufactures a wide range of personal care products, including skincare, hair care, body
care, oral care and cosmetic items. Our offerings include facial creams, moisturizers, cleansers,
serums, hair shampoos, conditioners, and more. We cater to both custom formulations and private
label manufacturing needs.

### [ Does Nutrix offer custom formulation services?][14]

Yes, Nutrix offers custom formulation services. Whether you're creating a brand-new product or
refining an existing formula, our experienced formulation engineers work closely with you to develop
a unique product tailored to your brand’s needs.

### [ How does Nutrix assist in product development from concept to completion?][15]

Nutrix supports every step of your product development journey. From the initial idea to the final
product, we provide expert assistance in formulation, manufacturing, packaging, and labeling. Our
team ensures that your product is developed to the highest standards and is ready for market quickly
and efficiently.

### [ Does Nutrix manufacture organic and natural products?][16]

Yes, Nutrix manufactures organic and natural products. We offer a range of formulations that meet
organic and natural standards, using high-quality ingredients that align with your brand's values
and customer expectations.

### [ Do you provide packaging solutions?][17]

Absolutely! Nutrix offers comprehensive packaging solutions, from design to sourcing. We help ensure
that your product is beautifully packaged and ready for retail, offering both standard and custom
packaging options to fit your needs.

### [ What certifications does Nutrix have for quality and compliance?][18]

Nutrix holds several certifications to ensure the highest standards of quality and compliance,
including:

NSF ISO 9001
SGS 22716
FDA Registered Facility
Organic Certification (OregonTilth & USDA Organic)
Kosher Certification
HACCP Certification
SMETA Certification These certifications demonstrate our commitment to maintaining the highest
manufacturing and safety standards.

### [ What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for manufacturing?][19]

The minimum order quantity (MOQ) varies depending on the product type and customization needs. Our
team works closely with you to determine the ideal MOQ for your specific product and business
requirements.

stock formulations are designed around current skin care trends, clean beauty expectations, and real

From packaging selection to labeling and regulatory alignment, we support private label skincare
brands operating in the USA and Canada to ensure products are market ready.

customer trust.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is product sampling in the private-label skincare manufacturing process?

Product sampling allows you to test and evaluate formulations before full-scale production. At
Sadatan, we provide samples of your custom private label skincare products so you can assess
quality, texture, and performance, ensuring the final product meets your brand’s standards.

What does Sadatan provide with its skincare private-label manufacturing service?

With Sadatan, you receive complete private-label solutions, including customized formulations,
packaging options, Documentation support, and full product development. We offer end-to-end services
to bring your brand’s vision to life, positioning us among trusted skin care private label
manufacturers.

What is private label skincare manufacturing, and how does it work?

Private-label skincare manufacturing involves creating custom products that are branded and sold
under your company’s name. Sadatan handles everything from formulation and production to packaging
and quality control, delivering ready-to-market products customized to your needs.

What is white labeling? Do you offer white label products?

White labeling is when a manufacturer produces generic products that can be rebranded by businesses.
Yes, Sadatan offers white labeling services, allowing you to brand and market our high-quality
formulations.

Is Sadatan a certified private label cosmetics manufacturer?

Yes, Sadatan is a certified private-label cosmetics manufacturer, adhering to global industry
standards and regulations to ensure high-quality, safe, and effective products for your brand. We
are among the trusted private label manufacturers committed to excellence.

How much influence do you have over private label cosmetic manufacturers?

At Sadatan, you have full control over your private-label cosmetics. As experienced private label
cosmetic manufacturers, we work closely with you to tailor formulations, packaging, and branding to
your exact specifications, ensuring that the final product aligns perfectly with your brand
identity.

What kinds of products does Sadatan manufacture?

Sadatan specializes in manufacturing beauty, personal care, wellness, and cosmetic products,
offering a range of solutions from skincare to haircare.

Which is India's best third-party haircare, personal care and skincare manufacturer?

Sadat

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is product sampling in the private-label skincare manufacturing process?

Product sampling allows you to test and evaluate formulations before full-scale production. At
Sadatan, we provide samples of your custom private label skincare products so you can assess
quality, texture, and performance, ensuring the final product meets your brand’s standards.

What does Sadatan provide with its skincare private-label manufacturing service?

With Sadatan, you receive complete private-label solutions, including customized formulations,
packaging options, Documentation support, and full product development. We offer end-to-end services
to bring your brand’s vision to life, positioning us among trusted skin care private label
manufacturers.

What is private label skincare manufacturing, and how does it work?

Private-label skincare manufacturing involves creating custom products that are branded and sold
under your company’s name. Sadatan handles everything from formulation and production to packaging
and quality control, delivering ready-to-market products customized to your needs.

What is white labeling? Do you offer white label products?

White labeling is when a manufacturer produces generic products that can be rebranded by businesses.
Yes, Sadatan offers white labeling services, allowing you to brand and market our high-quality
formulations.

Is Sadatan a certified private label cosmetics manufacturer?

Yes, Sadatan is a certified private-label cosmetics manufacturer, adhering to global industry
standards and regulations to ensure high-quality, safe, and effective products for your brand. We
are among the trusted private label manufacturers committed to excellence.

How much influence do you have over private label cosmetic manufacturers?

At Sadatan, you have full control over your private-label cosmetics. As experienced private label
cosmetic manufacturers, we work closely with you to tailor formulations, packaging, and branding to
your exact specifications, ensuring that the final product aligns perfectly with your brand
identity.

What kinds of products does Sadatan manufacture?

Sadatan specializes in manufacturing beauty, personal care, wellness, and cosmetic products,
offering a range of solutions from skincare to haircare.

# Best Third Party Pharma Manufacturer in India

[ Partner With Us ][33]

## Our Manufacturing Capabilities

Transforming formulations into market-ready healthcare products, Precision manufacturing backed by
innovation, quality, and trust.

## Third Party Enquiry Form

Filling our enquiry form is the first step towards getting in touch with us. It helps us understand
your requirements better and enables us to provide you with a personalized solution.

## WHY CHOOSE US

###### THE REASONS THAT YOU SHOULD CONTACT US
* **Leading Third-Party Manufacturer**– We are a leading third-party manufacturer producing
  high-quality pharmaceutical products, including General Health Tablets, Vitamin B Complex Syrup,
  Eye Drops, Liver Tonics, Multivitamins, Syrups & Capsules, Injections, herbals, nutraceuticals,
  syrups.
* **Our Manufacturing Units**– We have our manufacturing units and can get your pharmaceutical
  products ready quickly. Our **3rd Party Manufacturing** Pharmaceuticals units have high-speed
  mixing machines, capsule and powder filling machines, loading, and capping units, air compressors
  and filtration machines, and other equipment.
* **PCD Pharma Ready Products**– Torso Healthcare also has ready products, and we give PCD Pharma
  franchise to business that needs prepared products. We have a ready stock of essential
  pharmaceuticals and fulfil all the orders on the go so companies can save time and serve their
  customers quickly.
* **Reasonable Prices**– Most of our products are available at affordable prices so that our clients
  can have a large margin on the products. All our products have the best artwork & designs
  regarding packaging and other aspects of medicine.
* **Client-Centric Approach**– We are a client-centric company dealing with putting customer
  satisfaction as our top priority. All our products go through strict quality checks so our clients
  can easily sell them at a larger profit margin.
* **Large Distribution Network**– We have a very large delivery network allowing us to deliver the
  product nationwide. Once you become our client, we will be able to timely deliver your order
  without any delay and with full safety.

Velnik India Limited is one of India’s most reputable, technologically advanced, and
infrastructurally strong manufacturers and suppliers in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG)
industry (non-food).

in their particular category. Our key purpose is establishing brands which can be relatable to the

## Message From Director

At Velnik Group, I am proud to be a part of an excellent team that strives on reaching this success
and greatness. I strongly believe in that the winds of change are intense and the world is looking
at us with anticipation and hope. We are gearing up for the future by establishing the key success
factors which are necessary to not only withstand the change but also to make optimum use of it. I,
Sukhdev Gehlot, being a Chairman of Velnik Group, is committed towards transparency, sound corporate
practices based on conscience, openness, fairness, professionalism and accountability paving the way
in building confidence among all the Stakeholders for achieving sustainable long term growth and
profitability.
[Know More][30]

#### About velnik

## Manufacturer and Supplier of Hair Care, Personal Care, and Hygiene Products

#### Manufacturing Scale & Technology

We house one of the largest manufacturing facilities in India for personal care products (140 bighas
of land), utilizing advanced, highly-equipped technology to ensure top-notch quality that matches
international standards.

#### Socially Conscious Production

Our commitment to a socially responsible manufacturing model, highlighted by the 75% female
workforce at our key production facility, is central to our identity. This commitment to empowerment
makes us a driving force for positive social change.

#### Decades of Expertise

Our market position is fortified by our promoters’ extensive experience (around three decades) in
the FMCG industry, providing deep market understanding and established relationships that ensure
consistent product quality and strategic growth.

#### Innovation and Quality Assurance

Every product is crafted with care and observation, developed in a state-of-the-art R&D lab,
acknowledging hair and skin suitability while focusing on natural extracts and stringent quality
standards.

## Global Reach: Our Footprint Across the World

Velnik India has successfully expanded its footprint, establishing a strong presence that spans
continents.

#### Why Velnik Store?

## Reason to choose us

### Cruelty-Free Manufacturing

We use only ingredients that are not tested on animals. Our products are developed without harming
or killing any animals, and every product is Halal Certified. settings.

### Chemical-Free Formulations

Our products are safe, healthy, and environmentally friendly. We use only natural ingredients to
ensure purity and long-term benefits for your skin and hair.

### Made in India

Velnik India is one of the leading Indian cosmetic manufacturers. We take pride in producing
high-quality products locally and strongly support Make in India.

### 100% Satisfaction Guaranteed

Our purpose goes beyond selling products — customer satisfaction is our highest priority. We provide
the best services and ensure every customer receives a fully satisfying experience.

## Become a Partner

Velnik India focuses on strengthening cooperation with our distributors and channel partners. Join
hands with us and unfold your success wings to fly with Velnik India.

What is collagen?

Collagen is the main protein in our bodies that helps support our strength, flexibility and
movement.**

Why is collagen important?

Around the age of 30, our body’s natural collagen production can start to decrease by 1% per year
which may lead to the appearance of fine lines, saggy skin, and bones and joints that just don’t
move like they used to. (We know…total bummer.)

Collagen peptides are a supplement that stimulate the activity of special cells in our body by
supplying the building blocks needed to produce new collagen.** In other words, collagen is a VIP,

complete protein. It includes 8 of 9 essential amino acids.)

Frequently Asked Questions
What is collagen?

Collagen is the main protein in our bodies that helps support our strength, flexibility and
movement.**

Why is collagen important?

Around the age of 30, our body’s natural collagen production can start to decrease by 1% per year
which may lead to the appearance of fine lines, saggy skin, and bones and joints that just don’t
move like they used to. (We know…total bummer.)

How does it work?

Collagen peptides are a supplement that stimulate the activity of special cells in our body by
supplying the building blocks needed to produce new collagen.** In other words, collagen is a VIP,
Very Important Protein, because it’s 1/3 of all the protein in our bodies. (BTW, collagen is not a
complete protein. It includes 8 of 9 essential amino acids.)

How do I get results?

Great question. Current research suggests consuming between 10-20g of collagen peptides per day (the
equivalent of 2-4 tablespoons). When taken daily in your coffee, smoothie, water, or even oatmeal,
you can begin to see and feel the benefits of collagen:**^
* Promotes skin elasticity and hydration
* Promotes bone and joint health
* Supports hair thickness
* Supports joint comfort and mobility
* Supports nail growth
* Promotes a youthful appearance

manufacturing, and filling services tailored to each client’s requirements, managed through fully
documented, GMP-aligned systems. With deep industry knowledge and in-house R&D capabilities, we help
brands turn concepts into production-ready formulas built to compete and scale.

"We’ve had such a positive experience working with Vicora! From the very beginning, Hamid has gone

timelines were met, helping us navigate challenges, or ensuring every detail was right, he always

provided me with valuable guidance throughout the process. I’m very grateful for their support and

continue to work together for the long term and grow together for mutual success!!!!!!!"

# INSPIRED BY NATURE … FORMULATED THROUGH SCIENCE

## ARE YOU READY TO START YOUR OWN SKIN CARE BUSINESS?

Is today the day that you take the first step towards creating your own brand? We can help.

For almost 30 years **Vitelle Labs** has been the manufacturing partner used and recommended by
National Skincare Brands, Plastic Surgeons, Dermatologists and Esthetic Professionals.

**Vitelle** is one of a handful of North American manufacturers who offer premium private label and
contract manufacturing services to the professional skincare market. **Vitelle** works with clients
of varying sizes to create unique, effective products sold in premium packaging and finely finished.
Let us help you bring your brand to life!

[Private Label Serum]
[Get Started][80]
[[Case Study]][81]


## WHY CHOOSE VITELLE LABS

### AWARD WINNING FORMULATIONS FOR PRIVATE LABEL

Vitelle manufactured products frequently receive industry awards for excellence. As a client you
have access to our highly acclaimed portfolio of products.

### SMALL-BATCH MANUFACTURING

To ensure optimal freshness and potency we manufacture our products more frequently and in smaller
batch sizes.

### CUSTOM PRODUCT FORMULATION & MANUFACTURING

Create your own formula. We will customize or create something special just for you – with minimums
starting at only 20 litres.

### GREEN MANUFACTURING PRACTICES

Eco-friendly manufacturing and a preference for plant derived ingredients appeal to savvy skincare
consumers.

## Enhance Your Wellness with Full Script Supplements at You Turn.

## We’re excited to introduce our new line of high-quality supplements from Full Script, now
## available at You Turn!


## Whether you’re looking for Oral Health support, Workout Essentials, or products for Aromatherapy
## & Massage, we have a wide range of categories to meet your needs. These supplements are designed
## to address vital health concerns like adrenal support, blood sugar management, bone health, and
## more.


## Support your immune system, improve GI function, promote joint health, and even aid in liver
## detox. From kids to adults, our supplements provide tailored care for every stage of life,
## including specialized support for thyroid and menopausal health. Embrace a holistic approach to
## your well-being with You Turn's trusted supplements.

[SHOP NOW][15]

## Medical Spa Ankeny, IA

## You Turn is located on S. Ankeny Blvd just south of Oralabor Road near Azik salon suites.


## While Ankeny is our home, we serve customers from many surrounding areas including Saylorville,
## Altoona, Grimes, Urbandale and Des Moines

At You Turn Skin Care we offer a wide range of medical spa services to help you achieve your skin
care goals. Our goal is to educate and provide natural results that will leave you feeling refreshed
and confident in your own skin. 

### Facials

Revitalize your skin with our luxurious facials, designed for a radiant and youthful glow.

### Peels

From Bio RePeel to MD Perfect peel and Glymed customized peels, we help you choose the peel right
for you

### Waxing

Get silky-smooth skin with our gentle and expert waxing services for a flawless finish!

### Dermaplanning

Smooth your skin with a dermaplane service that removes the vellus hair and dead skin to help makeup
and skincare lay flawlessly.

### Lashes & Brows

Curl your lashes with a lash lift or tame brows with a lamination, with or without tint.

### Injectables

We use Jeuveau neurotoxin and Revanesse Versa Plus dermal filler

### Microneedling

Microneedle your skin with our Skin Pen treatment to minimize pores, improve texture, and reduce
acne scarring.

### LED Light Therapy

Enhance your facial or use as a standalone service for mood, wrinkles, or pain: our celluma LED
light therapy provides blue, red and near infrared light to meet all of your needs.

### Tixel

Experience skin resurfacing without a laser. Tixel uses thermo mechanical action to tighten loose
skin after GLP-1 use, aging and volume loss while repairing texture and pigmentation.

### Hydrofacial

Our hydrodermabrasion uses a customized treatment to clean your pores, exfoliate, and soften skin
for a flawless finish.

At You Turn Skin Care we offer a wide range of medical spa services to help you achieve your skin
care goals. Our goal is to educate and provide natural results that will leave you feeling refreshed
and confident in your own skin. 

### Facials

Revitalize your skin with our luxurious facials, designed for a radiant and youthful glow.

### Peels

From Bio RePeel to MD Perfect peel and Glymed customized peels, we help you choose the peel right
for you

### Waxing

Get silky-smooth skin with our gentle and expert waxing services for a flawless finish!

### Dermaplanning

Smooth your skin with a dermaplane service that removes the vellus hair and dead skin to help makeup
and skincare lay flawlessly.

### Lashes & Brows

Curl your lashes with a lash lift or tame brows with a lamination, with or without tint.

### Injectables

We use Jeuveau neurotoxin and Revanesse Versa Plus dermal filler

### Microneedling

Microneedle your skin with our Skin Pen treatment to minimize pores, improve texture, and reduce
acne scarring.

### LED Light Therapy

Enhance your facial or use as a standalone service for mood, wrinkles, or pain: our celluma LED
light therapy provides blue, red and near infrared light to meet all of your needs.

### Tixel

Experience skin resurfacing without a laser. Tixel uses thermo mechanical action to tighten loose
skin after GLP-1 use, aging and volume loss while repairing texture and pigmentation.

### Hydrofacial

Our hydrodermabrasion uses a customized treatment to clean your pores, exfoliate, and soften skin
for a flawless finish.
